title: External Electronics Enclosure Assembly

parts.name: External Tray
parts.note: 125 × 90 × 35 stationary base; common locating/through-bolt interfaces, service windows and cable exits; USB support belongs to replaceable ESP mount.

parts.name: Insulating adhesive feet
parts.note: Four Ø8 × 6 allowances, moved clear of tie anchors and underside nuts. Verify compressed height, ties and screw-tip clearance to bench.

parts.name: ESP32 Mount
parts.note: Replaceable ESP mount; four landing posts, locating stops and genuinely roofed side-entry nut pockets.

parts.name: Driver Mount
parts.note: Replaceable driver mount; four plain M2 bored posts. Board-specific pattern is confined to this part.

parts.name: Carrier Retainer
parts.note: Bears on printed hard-stop columns, with deliberate capture play over the prepared carrier; independent of module-to-base screws.

parts.name: Prepared insulating socket carrier
parts.note: 60 × 40 × 1.6 allowance. Reserve bare edge strips and landing areas; no carrier or ESP32 holes assumed. Measure actual flatness and thickness.

parts.name: ESP32 female socket rows
parts.note: Row length, width, spacing, height and origin are configurable. Overall board outline is not a confirmed header datum.

parts.name: Carrier solder and pin allowance
parts.note: Measured solder peaks must fit the clearance budget including carrier play, print error and extra solder allowance. Print the carrier coupon first.

parts.name: ESP32 development-board envelope
parts.note: USB left; BOOT/EN and headers accessible from open top. No confirmed board revision or hole pattern. Socket friction/USB retention requires physical testing.

parts.name: ESP32 module, USB and buttons
parts.note: Simplified shapes only. Verify antenna copper/wiring keepout and actual controls before preparing the carrier.

parts.name: SimpleFOC Mini v1.0 reference PCB
parts.note: 26 × 21.5; four Ø2 holes on22 × 17.5 reference centers. Outline is simplified, not the actual scalloped board. Never force M2.5 through PCB holes.

parts.name: Driver IC and connector allowances
parts.note: Required control row front, motor header rear, supply left. Verify populated rows, pin order, component heights and safe head bearing areas on delivered board.

parts.name: ESP mount M2.5 × 10 screws
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Two through-bolts release this complete mount. Kit head unconfirmed; Ø5.5 × 3 envelope. Hold ordinary underside nuts with a wrench.

parts.name: ESP mount M2.5 underside nuts
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: AF5 × 2 allowance. Ordinary accessible underside nuts, not printed threads or claimed captive pockets.

parts.name: DRIVER mount M2.5 × 10 screws
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Two through-bolts release this complete mount. Kit head unconfirmed; Ø5.5 × 3 envelope. Hold ordinary underside nuts with a wrench.

parts.name: DRIVER mount M2.5 underside nuts
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: AF5 × 2 allowance. Ordinary accessible underside nuts, not printed threads or claimed captive pockets.

parts.name: Frame M2.5 × 10 screws
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Fastens frame independently to ESP mount. Preload closes on printed hard stops; nominal carrier capture play0.4, no intentional PCB compression.

parts.name: Frame captive M2.5 nut — front
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Slide into side port before frame. Solid roof above nut prevents upward withdrawal; installed screw prevents escape through side entry.

parts.name: Frame captive M2.5 nut — rear
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Slide into side port before frame. Solid roof above nut prevents upward withdrawal; installed screw prevents escape through side entry.

parts.name: Insulating M2 × 12 driver screws
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Additional stock: commercial insulating screws. Ø4 × 2.5 head allowance; verify actual shaft fit and component-free bearing areas.

parts.name: Insulating M2 driver nuts
parts.kind: Commercial hardware allowance — actual stock unmeasured
parts.note: Additional stock, AF4 × 1.6 allowance. Fit off case; generic base service window leaves clearance after module installation.

steps.title: Modular kit
steps.text: Four printed parts: common tray, ESP32 mount, driver mount and carrier retaining frame. Both electronics mounts are assembled off the case.
steps.fact: Candidate CAD only. Print the retention coupon, carrier coupon and driver coupon before a full enclosure.

steps.title: Prepare the common base
steps.text: Deburr the tray and fit insulating feet. Fit cable ties before the modules; keep the underside nuts and service openings accessible.
steps.fact: Case 125 × 90 × 35 mm. Feet Ø8 × 6 are unmeasured allowances, positioned clear of tie slots and nuts.

steps.title: Prepare the ESP32 module
steps.text: Support the ESP mount outside the case. Slide one M2.5 nut into each outward-facing side port, beneath the solid roofs. Lower the prepared socket carrier onto its four landing posts.
steps.fact: Nut wells AF5.4, entry width6.4; each roof is 4.2 mm thick. Short bridge print quality must be checked on the coupon.

steps.title: Close the carrier retaining frame
steps.text: Lower the frame and fit its two M2.5 screws. The frame seats on printed hard-stop columns. It captures the carrier edge strips with deliberate play; it does not intentionally compress the PCB.
steps.fact: Frame screws M2.5 × 10; carrier capture gap 0.4 mm nominal. Side-loaded nuts bear against the solid roof, giving a positive load path into the mount.

steps.title: Seat the ESP32
steps.text: Seat the ESP32 evenly into the measured socket arrangement, USB facing left. Keep BOOT/EN, GPIO and antenna areas clear. Check actual plug insertion and socket retention.
steps.fact: Overall board envelope 55 × 28, socket spacing 25.4 and socket origin remain provisional. No ESP32 holes are assumed.

steps.title: Prepare the driver module
steps.short: Driver and four insulating M2 bolts
steps.text: Support the driver mount off the case. Place the PCB on four posts, insert four insulating M2 screws and fit four insulating nuts from below while access is unrestricted.
steps.fact: M2 × 12, additional stock. Reference Ø2 holes on 22 × 17.5; delivered board unconfirmed. Never use M2.5 through the PCB.

steps.title: Install complete modules
steps.text: Lift each completed module above the rim, translate over its bay, then lower onto the common locating pins and bearing pads. Electronics remain secured to their modules throughout this move.
steps.fact: Both bays use a 24 × 52 diagonal two-hole interface and z5 seating plane. Outlines differ; replacement mounts must stay within bay and service-window limits.

steps.title: Fasten modules to the base
steps.text: Insert two M2.5 screws per mount and hold their ordinary underside nuts with a wrench. ESP frame access notches admit the module screw heads and tools without dismantling its electronics.
steps.fact: Four M2.5 × 10 base screws. Remove only those two screws to lift either complete module. Frame screws remain installed in its captive nuts.

steps.title: Complete stationary enclosure
steps.text: Inspect insulation, cable restraint, carrier play, feet and socket seating before powered tests. Check temperatures under the intended bench load. This enclosure stays separate from the balancing cube.
steps.fact: Four production prints; six M2.5 screws/nuts and four insulating M2 screws/nuts. No washers or bought spacers in the nominal stack. Physical fit, strength and thermal behavior remain unverified.

modules.load_path: head → removable plate → base support/floor → underside nut; two independent through-bolts per module

frame.load_path: head → frame/hard-stop column → solid pocket roof → nut → screw; independent of enclosure fastening

driver.load_path: insulating head → PCB at four reference holes → printed posts/plate → insulating underside nuts; preassemble off case

notice: Modular preliminary CAD: four production prints, ten screws. Print fit coupons first. Boards, sockets, hardware, print tolerances and strength remain physically unverified.
assembly_note: Preassemble electronics off case. Complete modules move rigidly above the rim before lowering; separate base screws release either complete mount.
